svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 240 x 88 mm from 6 mm plate; square, deburr, break the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ten 4.5 mm holes, 5 mm in from the long edges, at 8, 64, 120,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 176 and 232 mm from the rear end (the same positions as the rim).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the lid and the hull rim together if you can (clamp, spot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through, then tap the rim M4).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pressure-test port: 8.5 mm hole tapped M10 x 1, 30 mm from the rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underside flat to 0.1 mm over the O-ring land; no scratches across it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits flush on the rim, O-ring in the rim groove, ten M4 x 12

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pan-head screws tightened evenly in a cross pattern.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid lies flat on the rim with no rock before the O-ring
